PLAN "12-Week Spine-Safe General Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength while protecting the lumbar spine"
  GOAL secondary mobility:
    name "Improve hip mobility and core stability"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body - Hip Hinge Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1m
          bird_dog 1m
          hip_circles 1m
          glute_bridge 1m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          figure_four_stretch 1m
          child_pose 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body - Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Upper Body - Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          scapular_retraction 1m
          prone_Y 1m
          prone_T 1m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
